def read_ints():
    return list(map(int, input().split()))

n, m = read_ints()
energies = read_ints()

# Create adjacency list for the graph
adj_list = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
for _ in range(m):
    x, y = read_ints()
    adj_list[x].append(y)
    adj_list[y].append(x)

# Initialize the total energy cost
total_energy = 0

# Set to keep track of parts that have been removed
removed = set()

# Priority queue to always remove the part with the least energy cost
import heapq

# Create a list of (energy, part) tuples and push all parts into the priority queue
pq = [(energies[i], i + 1) for i in range(n)]
heapq.heapify(pq)

# Process until all parts are removed
while pq:
    # Get the part with the least energy cost
    energy, part = heapq.heappop(pq)
    
    # If the part has already been removed, continue
    if part in removed:
        continue
    
    # Add the energy cost of removing this part
    total_energy += energy
    
    # Mark this part as removed
    removed.add(part)
    
    # Remove all parts connected to this part
    for neighbor in adj_list[part]:
        if neighbor not in removed:
            # Decrease the energy of the connected part by the energy of the removed part
            for i in range(n):
                if pq[i][1] == neighbor:
                    pq[i] = (pq[i][0] - energy, neighbor)
                    break
            heapq.heapify(pq)

print(total_energy)
